0.long_answer: Vimizim (elosulfase alfa) is a recombinant enzyme therapy that was approved by the FDA in 2014 for the treatment of mucopolysaccharidosis IVA (MPS IVA). This lysosomal storage disorder is caused by a deficiency in the enzyme N-acetylgalactosamine-6-sulfatase. The drug works by replacing the deficient enzyme, thereby helping to reduce the accumulation of glycosaminoglycans that lead to the disease's symptoms. Its approval marked a significant advancement in targeted treatment options for patients with this rare congenital enzyme disorder.
